author: crispai
body:
Lets say you don't want to buy keys for crates.. Maybe you could sell crates for credits. The higher tier crate you have, the more credits it sells for. Or possibly a market to put them on and people will buy them for credits. It is just a little idea that I had for the next update..

Beta crate: 250 credits
Alpha crate: 500 credits
Gamma crate: 750 or 1000 credits?

And for the market, you can set your own price for the crates.

Thanks,
-Cris
